documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For Second Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Acutaas Chemicals Limited reported strong financial performance for Q2 FY27, delivering revenue of ₹4,369 million representing a 42.7% year-on-year growth, driven by momentum in the Pharmaceutical Intermediates business. Management highlighted the inauguration of their South Korea manufacturing facility ahead of schedule, aimed at the semiconductor ecosystem. Backed by improved revenue visibility and a robust order pipeline, management revised the FY27 revenue growth guidance upward from 25% to around 30% and raised the EBITDA margin guidance to the 38-40% range. Acutaas Chemicals Limited reported robust financial performance for Q1 FY27, delivering 59.1% Y-o-Y revenue growth to reach INR329.7 crores alongside significant margin expansion. Management expressed confidence in achieving a 25% revenue growth target for the full financial year with stable margins.

guidance.claim: The management is confident of delivering 25% revenue growth for the full year with stable margins.
guidance.quote: To conclude, we have started the new financial year on a strong note and I remain confident of delivering 25% revenue growth for the full year with stable margins.

guidance.claim: The company expects a similar kind of EBITDA margin for the full financial year as achieved in full year FY26.
guidance.quote: For current financial year, for the full year, as we guided during the commentary also, we are expecting a similar kind of margin as we had for full year FY '26.

guidance.claim: The management targets hitting INR1,000 crores in revenue from the CDMO business and is confident of beating this target.
guidance.quote: Let me give you -- let me address your question other way around. Let's say, we have already guided the market that we would be hitting INR1,000 crores revenue from our CDMO business. That is based on our confidence and looking at our upcoming product pipeline for our CDMO business. And we are very much confident to not only achieve this target. And in fact, we are confident to beat this target.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment for products remains strong as reflected in the quarter's results, with healthy RFP activity across CDMO and NCE products.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment for our products remains strong as reflected in the quarter's results. We continue to see healthy RFP activity across our CDMO and NCE products.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for battery chemicals remains exceptionally strong, driven by tight global supply.
demand_outlook.quote: Within Specialty Chemicals, demand for battery chemicals remain exceptionally strong. I'm pleased to share that we have successfully completed the trial run of our battery chemicals plant and started commercial supply. Demand here is unprecedented, driven by tight global supply and we, therefore, expect a rapid ramp-up over the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: AI is pushing CPU demand higher, pulling memory chip demand up along with it in a structural phase.
demand_outlook.quote: What we are seeing is that AI is starting to push CPU demand higher and that's pulling memory chip demand up right along with it. At a time when supply is already tight. To us, this isn't the passing phase. It is a structural phase.

demand_outlook.claim: Ongoing engagement with customers reinforces conviction that memory chip demand will remain strong.
demand_outlook.quote: Our ongoing engagement with customers reinforces our conviction that memory chip demand will remain strong.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for Q1 FY27 was INR56 crores, with INR15 crores at the Indichem site and INR41 crores primarily at the ACL site for battery chemical projects, Sachin site pilot plant, and maintenance.
capex_expansion.quote: Now turning to the capital expenditures. capex for Q1 FY '27 stood at INR56 crores, out of which INR15 crores were at the Indichem site, remaining INR41 crores in ACL site, which is primarily diverted towards the battery chemical project at the Jhaghadia site. And then pilot plant at our Sachin site and maintenance capex.

capex_expansion.claim: Additional capex will be incurred for a new R&D center and land acquisition for further capacity expansion, which will be updated when finalized.
capex_expansion.quote: As mentioned on our previous earnings call, we will incur additional capex for a new R&D center and for the acquisition of land for further capacity expansion, we will update the market once these projects are finalized.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the Indichem plant in Korea is expected to be completed by the end of the current quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: So this plant, we are happy to share that this is getting constructed even before the schedules and expected to get -- capex is expected to get completed by end of this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for the quarter was INR190.9 crores, with gross margin expanding by 466 basis points Y-o-Y to 57.9%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit for the quarter was INR190.9 crores, reflecting a 73% increase compared to the same period last year. The gross margin expanded by 466 basis points Y-o-Y to 57.9%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR113.1 crores, with EBITDA margin up 973 basis points Y-o-Y at 34.3%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR113.1 crores, which represents more than twofold increase compared to the EBITDA of the same period last year. EBITDA margin were at 34.3%, up 973 basis points Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for the quarter was INR74.9 crores, up 70.4% Y-o-Y, with PAT margins at 22.7%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT for the quarter was INR74.9 crores, up 70.4% Y-o-Y. PAT margins for the quarter were at 22.7%, which show an expansion of 151 basis points Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: Specialty chemicals business has around 24% margin and the pharma business has around 36% margin.
margins_costs.quote: So with regard to margin, our Spec Chem business is having around 24% margin and Pharma business is having around 36% margin.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins were driven by a better product mix and operational efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: Driven by better product mix and operational efficiencies

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for the Sachin unit is 83%, Unit 2 at Ankleshwar is 23%, and Unit 3 Jhagadia is 55% for the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Okay. For the capacity utilization for the Sachin unit, the capacity is 83%. For Unit 2 at Ankleshwar, it is 23% and at Unit 3 Jhagadia, 55% for the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The battery chemical plant has a capacity of 2,000 metric tons for VC and 2,000 metric tons for FEC, totaling 4,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So you know that the plant, we have a capacity of 2,000 metric tons for VC and 2,000 metric tons for FEC. So it's a total 4,000 metric ton capacity and for which we are more than confident that we will be able to hit the full capacity utilization by end of 3 years.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash and cash equivalents were around INR314 crores as on June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash and cash equivalents were around INR314 crores as on 30th June 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital for the quarter stands at 99 days versus 91 days in Q4 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Our working capital for the quarter stands at 99 days versus 91 days in Q4 FY '26.

risks_headwinds.claim: The financial year began on a turbulent note driven by geopolitical tensions in the Gulf, which persist.
risks_headwinds.quote: We began the financial year on a turbulent note, driven by geopolitical tensions in the Gulf. While these tensions persist, our team has done a commendable work in securing raw material availability and ensuring supply continuity.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects revenue from four validated CDMO products to kick in from H2 FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And with regulatory approval in place, we are expecting revenue to kick in from H2 FY '27 onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial revenue from the Indichem plant is expected to begin from next financial year onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And maybe from next financial year onwards, we will have the revenue coming up from that plant.

management_commitments.claim: The Phase 2 capex for the third product of the Electrolyte Additives segment will be completed by the end of Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And as we mentioned earlier also by end of Q2 FY '27, we would be completing our capex.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
